title: ဂျပန် VTuber က အမေ့ကို|「VTuber လုပ်နေတယ်」လို့ ဖွင့်ပြောတဲ့အခါ 😂
credit: 元動画：【カミングアウト】ママにVtuberやってるって言う！ぺこ！【ホロライブ/兎田ぺこら】
context: hololive VTuber Usada Pekora (talks with a rabbit-girl character, ends sentences with ぺこ, calls her mother マミー) live-streams a phone/voice call with her real mother and confesses that she works as a VTuber. Wholesome family comedy.
